title: Mid-semester exam schedule
body: Mid-semester exams: Data Structures on 18 Nov, Operating Systems on 20 Nov, Database Systems on 22 Nov. All exams start at 10:00 in the Main Hall.

title: Library hours extended
body: The central library stays open until midnight from 10 Nov to 25 Nov.

title: Hackathon registration
body: Registration for the campus hackathon closes on 15 Nov. Teams of 2-4. Register at the student activity office.

title: Hall ticket update
body: Exam cell circular 47. Hall tickets are being issued by email this semester. To receive yours before 16 Nov, send your roll number, date of birth and phone number to exam-cell-helpdesk@college-portal.example.
